# A range value variable used as an operand of a depth-2 expression must not be hoisted as a broadcast scalar.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .

! stderr .

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func IncrAdd(a, b, incr []float32) {
	for i, v := range a {
		incr[i] += v + b[i]
	}
}
